scenes.purpose: A grounded presenter shifts weight, raises a hand, follows with the head and holds the finished gesture.

visual.title: Settle, gesture, and come to rest

narration.text: The presenter settles into a stance, then raises a hand.
The head follows the gesture, and the arm comes gently to rest.

scenes.purpose: A rigid gripper descends, closes around a separate sample, pauses, lifts clear of the pedestal and only then carries the sample sideways.

narration.text: The gripper lowers over the sample and closes its jaws.
It pauses, then lifts the sample clear of the pedestal.
Only after clearing the surface does it carry the sample aside.

scenes.purpose: A butterfly follows a moving leaf, prepares its wings, releases contact, tucks its feet and flies away with an asymmetric stroke rhythm and a small settling bank.

narration.text: The butterfly rests as the leaf moves beneath it.
A small opening of the wings prepares it to take off.
It lifts its feet, beats its wings, and flies away.
